svg.text: FEAR PASS · LANTERN WARDEN · TRUE FORM · ROUND 2
H 3.10 m · stoops to 2.50 m · ≤ 10k tris
Kettle hat as the lantern's cap
Head: a cage of four bone bars
hangs open; one eye still looks
the candle burns in the chest
The glaive grown into the arm
His lantern, dark on the floor
its flame left it for him
the light carried low and ahead
m under the 2.59 m arch; the
